concepts.name: Implications Of Digital Technology On Ci
concepts.simple_definition: Implications of digital technology on citizens Digital technologies have advanced more rapidly than ever before in human history- reaching many people of the world and creates positive and negative impacts on citizen's’ emotions, social life and ethical values
concepts.deep_explanation: A good and moderate use of digital technology leads citizens to positive effects where as, extremely excessive and addictive use of digital technology leads citizens to negative effects
concepts.real_example: Practical example of Implications of digital technology on ci from page 33.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse Implications of digital technology on ci with adjacent topics in Chapter 2.
concepts.name_amharic: Implications of digital technology on ci (በአማርኛ)
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] Implications of digital technology on citizens Digital technologies have advanced more rapidly than ever before in human history- reaching many people of the world and creates positive and negative impacts on citizen's’ emotions, social life and ethical values (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ10ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] A good and moderate use of digital technology leads citizens to positive effects where as, extremely excessive and addictive use of digital technology leads citizens to negative effects — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: [አማርኛ] በገጽ 33 ላይ ያለውን ተግባራዊ ምሳሌ ይመልከቱ።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: [አማርኛ] ተማሪዎች ይህንን ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ከሌሎች ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ጋር ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ።

concepts.deep_explanation: They can threaten privacy, erode ethical and cultural values, erode security, and fuel inequality

concepts.name: 2.1.1 Implications Of Digital Technology
concepts.simple_definition: 2.1.1 Implications of digital technology on citizens emotions The use of digital technology is intricately related to our emotional processes
concepts.deep_explanation: From within a person, emotions alter the patterns of technology use; from outside, technology use alters a person’s emotions
concepts.real_example: Practical example of 2.1.1 Implications of digital technology from page 35.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse 2.1.1 Implications of digital technology with adjacent topics in Chapter 2.

concepts.name: Fostering Socialization The Presence Of
concepts.simple_definition: Fostering socialization The presence of technologies in human behaviors enables people to communicate and foster beneficial interpersonal relationships
concepts.deep_explanation: By reaching out to others, engaging in meaningful social interactions and strengthening our social bonds, we are likely to improve our wellbeing
concepts.real_example: Practical example of Fostering socialization The presence of  from page 37.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse Fostering socialization The presence of  with adjacent topics in Chapter 2.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] Fostering socialization The presence of technologies in human behaviors enables people to communicate and foster beneficial interpersonal relationships (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ10ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።

concepts.simple_definition: Supporting happiness and wellbeing When people make video calls to talk to people all over the world, it gives a sense of purpose, joy or excitement
concepts.deep_explanation: Social media, for example, is a place where people can connect socially and engage in kind and helpful behavior - activities that have been shown to boost health and wellbeing
